children: TAIPEI, Sept. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- To address the growing demands across cold chain logistics, warehousing, and manufacturing, Unitech introduces the HT730 Plus Rugged Handheld Terminal. Featuring a dedicated Cold Chain model operating down to -30°C, 32-meter long-range scanning, 5G, Wi-Fi 6E, and eSIM, the device enhances operational efficiency across industrial environments. Powered by Android 14 with Google Mobile Services (GMS) and Android Enterprise Recommended (AER), the HT730 Plus delivers reliable performance for enterprise workflows.

In cold storage and freezing environments, extremely low temperatures can cause slow screen responses and reduced device performance. The HT730 Plus Cold Chain model features an integrated heater module for stable operation down to -30°C, helping prevent abnormal screen responses, internal condensation, data loss, and operational downtime. Furthermore, the device offers IP65/IP67 dust and water protection and withstands 2.4-meter drops with a bumper, providing robust, enterprise-grade protection for cold storage facilities.

With a barcode reading range of up to 32 meters, the HT730 Plus allows workers to scan high warehouse racks and distant pallets safely from the ground. It supports a wide range of symbologies, including 1D, 2D, DotCode, and OCR, enabling accurate data capture while reducing manual data entry errors. The ergonomic 30-degree tilt-down scanning design, combined with keypad options (29 or 38 keys), facilitates comfortable one-handed operation and reduces worker fatigue during intensive scanning shifts.

Driven by the Qualcomm® Snapdragon™ 4490 Octa-core processor, the HT730 Plus delivers powerful performance for data-intensive enterprise applications. It also incorporates advanced wireless technologies, including 5G, Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth® 5.2, supporting reliable, real-time data transmission.

Notably, the integration of eSIM technology enables secure, hassle-free network provisioning, simplifying large-scale device deployment and connectivity management by eliminating the need to manually install or replace SIM cards on individual devices.

Additionally, SmartPA technology improves audio quality and volume while helping protect the speaker from electrical and thermal damage, enabling clearer alerts and voice communication in noisy work environments.
Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Taiwan, Unitech Electronics Co., Ltd. (
) provides AIDC and IoT solutions, including mobile computers, rugged PDAs, industrial tablets, barcode scanners, and RFID readers.
With over 40 years of experience, Unitech supports digital transformation across logistics, retail, warehousing, manufacturing, government, transportation, and field services.
